title: CRBN with lenalidomide, recruiting IKZF1
shows: The cleanest case in the set. The molecule sits deep in cereblon's pocket and presents a small, strongly directional face, and the zinc finger covers almost all of it -- 94% of the presented face buried, the highest of the fourteen. It is also the only system where the built-in docking engine recovered the crystal placement, so it is the one example where every stage of the tool can be run end to end.
